title: RBF Kernel Parameter Formula for Data Classification Methods
summary: Radial Basis Function (RBF), or Gaussian, kernels are among the most widely used parametric kernels in machine learning, particularly in methods such as Support Vector Machines (SVM) and kernel-based subspace approaches. The kernel parameter $γ$ (or $σ$ in the Gaussian formulation) must be carefully tuned, as the performance of these methods strongly depends on its value and is highly sensitive to improper selection.
